Armed with the ambition, necessity and idealism of youth, Charlize, Kheng, and Sani enter the Prison Service with very different goals. Behind prison walls, the rookies quickly learn that the job is not just about discipline and control, but trust, rehabilitation and second chances. They will learn some of their most valuable lessons about life, love and sacrifice from the people they least expect — inmates, colleagues, ex-convicts and their families.

Best Telenovela - National Winner Asian Academy Creative Awards (2020) | Kin is a drama about the complexities of life, love and family relationships. Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life. Has the nature vs nurture battle run its course or are relationships between the families still as fraught and complicated as ever? The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

Brand new series where the UK's most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europe's busiest food markets.

Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

p.d: The illicit affair of a married Palestinian man and a married Israeli woman in Jerusalem takes a dangerous political dimension when they are spotted in the wrong place at the wrong time leaving them to deal with more than their broken marriages.

p.t: The Grump: In Search Of An Escort
p.d: The Grump, a stubborn old Finnish farmer, goes on a quest to find a replacement for his beloved second-hand car. He goes to Germany to do so, but ends up settling accounts with his past.

Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

Traumatized policeman Ben delves into his own past to investigate a cold case obscured by a web of guilt, lies and deception. In the process, Marion, a doctor, helps him come to terms with himself and his past.
Fusi is in his forties and yet to find courage to enter the adult world. He sleepwalks through everyday life, where routine is key. Unexpected events force him to make drastic decisions.

A week in the life of Moha, Valero and Pep - workers in a small plumbing and electricity company in the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. Moha is on a one-week trial period and is set to replace Pep, but Valero doesn't think he has what it takes.

In snowy and desolate South Eastern Anatolian, Musa carries the corpse of his deceased wife to their homeland with his granddaughter. As they get closer to a country at war, their run-in with the police separates them in different directions.

Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Chantal are worlds apart. When their parents go away for the summer, their simmering sibling rivalry threatens to boil over, especially when the mysterious boy next door moves back in.

They trusted her. Then, a series of mysterious deaths raised a chilling question: what, if anything, connected them? At the centre of the case is Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, widely known as “Aem Cyanide”, whom police came to suspect in a number of deaths across Thailand. What began as an investigation into individual cases soon widened as police uncovered possible connections between them. Cyanide became a key focus, while questions emerged over money and the ‘sharing circle’ relationships which Aem had with some who died. With rare access to those closest to the case, the series goes inside an investigation that gripped Thailand and left families searching for answers. As new details come to light, it traces how suspicion fell on Aem and examines the evidence that turned a series of mysterious deaths into one of Thailand’s most extraordinary criminal investigations.

p.t: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
p.d: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment.
